svg.title: NET-02 — Wildcard host setup with optional password
svg.desc: 850 by 700 logical canvas with fixed banner and endpoint fields. The main canvas shows Configure alone. The annotated alternate row shows the masked editor and trailing Remove in the same allocation. Both setup panels/list bodies extend 44 logical px downward to expose ten complete rows while headings and first rows stay fixed. Count and conditional feedback move down by 44. Bottom-left logical action bounds are Start session (117,38,300,32) and Back (433,38,300,32), translated exactly to this SVG's canvas origin (25,20). Other diagram positions remain approximate; the NET-02 geometry table owns exact list bounds. Valid idle setup has no listing/direct-play help or readiness text. Port keeps initial focus; popup/progress behavior is unchanged.

g.text: Annotation: Read top to bottom; left setup panel before right.
Bottom-left: actions y=38, height 32; panels end at y=158; count y=138; feedback y=94.
Both lists gain 44 px. Conditional feedback stays above actions; idle feedback remains blank.
